mods.description: Pick Vanilla Tweaks resource packs in game. The list comes live from vanillatweaks.net, so it is always the site's current one. Unofficial, not made by the Vanilla Tweaks team.

releases.notes:
- **New look:** flat and dark like Sodium's settings, with the mod's icon in the sidebar (animated).
- **Search:** a box at the top right searches every category at once, over pack names, descriptions and category names. Words in any order; case, spaces and punctuation don't matter.
- **Icon:** the mod now has one.

Needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, internet access. Mod Menu optional.

Unofficial, not made by the Vanilla Tweaks team.

mods.name: VT Picker
mods.description: Pick Vanilla Tweaks resource packs in game. The list comes live from vanillatweaks.net, so it is always the site's current one. Unofficial, not made by the Vanilla Tweaks team.

releases.notes:
First release. Pick [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net) resource packs in game, without the browser.

- **Options > Resource Packs > Vanilla Tweaks** (top left), or Mod Menu.
- Categories and pack tiles like on the site, with icons, descriptions on hover, and clashing packs swapped out
  when you pick one.
- The pack list comes live from vanillatweaks.net every time the screen opens, so new tweaks show up without a
  mod update.
- **Apply** or **Done** builds the pack on the site, puts it on top of your resource packs and reloads.
- Picks are saved right away and kept across restarts.

Needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, internet access. Mod Menu optional.

Unofficial, not made by the Vanilla Tweaks team.
